newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Savings Bank 1996 profit 64.8 mln kroons.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Savings Bank 1996 profit 64.8 mln kroons.

text.p: Estonia's second largest bank Savings Bank on Wednesday said its 1996 profit was 64.78 million kroons after 27.86 million kroons in 1995.
The bank, quoted on the Tallinn stock exchange, said in a statement that its profit increase in December was a record 9.31 million kroons.

It also said that assets grew in 1996 by 1.75 billion kroons to 4.34 billion kroons. The main reason for the balance sheet growth was the rise in deposits which grew by 48.3 percent to 3.14 billion kroons. The net loan portfolio grew during 1996 by 1.22 billion kroons to 2.22 billion kroons.
The quickest rise in assets came from its securities portfolio, which rose by 523.7 million kroons to 855.26 million kroons.
Shareholder capital rose by 175 million kroons to 327.89 million kroons.
